name: markdownweb
description: A Go module for the protocol layer of the Markdown web: fetch a page as Markdown (BonBon's Accept, the declared alternate link, the .md sibling), read a site's toc.opml and find a page's neighbours, browse a site on disk, and convert HTML to a Markdown reader view.
releaseNotes:
- fetch: new Fetcher.GetIf and Validators, a conditional request (If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since) with the same pause, retry and robots rules as Get. Result gains ETag, LastModified and NotModified (true on a 304); Get fills the first two. Asked for by cmarkfind's remote fill (cmarkfind DR-0001)
- no other behaviour change
